# RxLabs®

> A research laboratory for artificial intelligence, neurotechnology and operating systems for heap-0 neuromorphic robotic runtimes. Non-profit organisation. Running code, public evidence and figures that can be measured again.

In the future, RxLabs® will become a real company, a Spanish limited company (S.L.), to build autonomous drones with echoAI and echOS.

Site: https://rxlabs.org/en
Documentation: https://rxlabs.org/en/docs
Contact: knightsys@proton.me
Discord: https://discord.gg/rxlabs
Complete text: https://rxlabs.org/en/llms-full.txt

## Projects

- **echOS 3.0** — edge robotics unikernel with a sensor→intent pipeline, safety gate and PX4 bridge. [Page](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/echos) · [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echos/que-es)
- **PRISMA** — EEG analysis for research with an event-driven Rust engine. [Page](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/prisma) · [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/prisma/resumen)
  - Exploratory intent → drone campaign: EEG, EMG and body control compared as sources of bounded intents that echoAI and echOS filter before the flight controller. No results of our own, no sensors, no drone; it does not read thoughts. [Campaign](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/docs/prisma/eeg-dron)
- **echoAI** — two-clock situated agent with a 16-byte WSP, CAM, T, Q and gate. ECHO-1 and ECHO-2 are closed; ECHO-3 has 14 of 15 software certificates and DRONE-3 has closed the integrated mission in SITL; HIL and cage still await hardware. [Page](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/echoai) · [Docs](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/que-es)

## ECHO-4

Development started on 21 September 2026. WORLD-1 is implemented; SENSATION-1 is next, followed by BOUNDARY-1 and SELF-1. Continuity, maintenance, counterpart, interaction, relationships, roles and integration follow. Hardware after software; METAVERSE-1 last.

[Roadmap](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/echo4) · [ECHO-4](https://www.rxlabs.org/en/articulos/echo4-inicio-roadmap-oficial)

## ECHO-3 now

ECHO-3 has **14 of 15 milestones with green certificates within their software scope** and DRONE-3 has closed its SITL leg. ECHO-1 and ECHO-2 are closed; the robotics programme remains open. Adding certificates does not amount to a mission on a physical robot: there is no hardware in the laboratory.

**TRANSFER-3** closed green on 19 September 2026 with a sealed campaign under human custody: B 342/576 missions against 44/576 nominal and 38/0 blocks; C 432/576 against 65/576 and 48/1 blocks, with zero losses attributable to the calibration. Static two-wall rooms; no hardware and no flight.

**DRONE-3** closed its SITL leg on 20 September 2026: the complete mission in a single PX4/Gazebo session, 12/12 flights in validation and 12/12 in confirmation, zero collisions and 228/228 refusal probes blocked per stage. The milestone also demands hardware-in-the-loop and a cage: `drone3_green` stays false. Energy is simulated charge, not measured joules. The laboratory has no robotics hardware or Akida.

- [Article: DRONE-3, the whole mission in simulation](https://rxlabs.org/en/articulos/drone3-mision-integrada-sitl)
- [DRONE-3](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/drone3)

- [Architecture](https://rxlabs.org/en/docs/echoai/piezas)

Results describe defined test banks. Do not attribute general autonomy, physical hardware or an LLM in echoAI’s fast loop.
